about: Fitted bid and word models of the real rivals, from public match data. Entry names by suffix: none (LetterShark, code, bot, dev-voices): matches up to 126; -v2 (and Yezi, tinytung, slow-n-dumb): refitted on matches up to 161 (rival-data-v2/refit.json); -ar: the live all-real 6-bot matches m147 to m190 (rival-data-v3/refit-allreal.json); -v4: refitted on the v4 snapshot (393 matches, 2026-10-24 06:00 UTC), all-real 6-seat matches only, each rival over its range in source (work/refit-v4.json), word policy from reconstructed racks (shark when a 7+ word was played in at least 90% of the gaps where one was available before auction 61), rho the bid-likelihood rack awareness (rival_v4_rho_fit.py; a field@rho suffix overrides it); -v4c: the same rivals with complete7, survival runs used when the letter completes a 7+ word on the rival's rack (regular cells fitted on the other auctions), and the word policy with the best likelihood (minLen: the hazard step plays only words of at least that length; sharkLen: words of at least that length are cashed first; work/refit-v4c.json). Survival bid: u ~ U(0,1), x = first run x with S < u (0 = no bid, none = 200), bid = round_half_even(x * (max(balance, 1) / 100) ^ beta) capped at balance; 0 on the final auction. Clock block by auctions still to come after this one (bagLeft): 0 if >= 18, 1 if 10-17, 2 if 5-9, 3 if 1-4 (auction idx 1-50, 51-58, 59-63, 64-67 of a 68-auction match). Value class: v1 AEIOULNSTR, v2 DG, v3 BCMP, v4 FHVWY, v5+ KJXQZ. Entries named -v5: refitted on the v5 snapshot (1318 matches, 2026-10-24 10:52 UTC), all-real 6-seat matches only, each bot over its latest stable range (the current top bots) or over m1000 on (the rest of the live field, for live-table validation), the -v4 method exactly. Entries named -v5c: the same rivals with the v4c extensions (complete7 bids, likelihood-chosen word policy). Entries named -v5u: the -v5c rivals with bids in three regimes, a letter that completes a 7+ word (complete7), one that adds to the greedy pack value of the rival's rack (cells) and one that adds nothing (dead: one curve per value class), rival_refit_v5u.py; rho fitted on the useful auctions; needs selfplay.ts with RivalModel.dead. Entries named -v5p: the -v5u rivals with five clock blocks, auctions 1-22, 23-50, 51-58, 59-63 and 64-67 (RivalModel.blockEdges [46, 18, 10, 5], by auctions still to come), cells and dead runs per value class and block, rival_refit_v5p.py.

-v5p: as -v5u with five clock blocks (auctions 1-22, 23-50, 51-58, 59-63, 64-67; blockEdges), rival_refit_v5p.py
